sources.entry: CoreShop - E-commerce plugin for Pimcore. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: CoreShop is an open-source e-commerce platform that runs on top of the Pimcore framework.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes CoreShop as a Pimcore-based eCommerce solution meant for building online stores. It states that CoreShop 2026.x ships a rewritten admin interface built on Pimcore Studio (React/TypeScript), with each CoreShop bundle providing its own Studio plugin loaded via Module Federation. The repository includes a monorepo-style build: installing frontend dependencies with npm, building all Studio plugins, and starting a dev server for a single bundle. The build auto-discovers bundles with Studio assets and compiles them in parallel. Requirements listed are Pimcore ^2026.2. Installation details, documentation, and a demo are referenced via external links rather than included in the README text.
use_cases: build an online store on Pimcore
run a product catalog and shop backend
develop Pimcore Studio plugins for shop bundles
notable: Built as an eCommerce layer on Pimcore's framework
Admin UI rewritten on Pimcore Studio in CoreShop 2026.x
Each bundle ships its own independently deployable Studio plugin via Module Federation
Build system auto-discovers and compiles bundle assets in parallel
caveats: Installation guide is external (in the documentation), not in the README
